operations.description: List the open pull requests that request the authenticated user's review, one page per call of at most per_page; since (an ISO 8601 date or date-time) keeps those updated at or after it; the walk ends on a page shorter than per_page, and the search serves at most 1,000 results

List the open issues and pull requests assigned to the authenticated user, one page per call of at most per_page; since keeps those updated at or after it; the walk ends on a page shorter than per_page

List the authenticated user's notifications, unread unless all is true, one page per call of at most per_page; since keeps those updated after it; the walk ends on a page shorter than per_page; nothing is marked as read
List an organization's repositories, one page per call of at most per_page, ordered by sort and direction; the walk ends on a page shorter than per_page
Read one repository by owner and repo: description, topics, homepage, stars, pushed_at, archived and visibility among its members
List a repository's releases, newest first, one page per call of at most per_page; the walk ends on a page shorter than per_page
Read a repository's latest published release, neither a draft nor a prerelease
Read a repository's README at ref, or its default branch, as text of at most 1 MiB
Read one file of a repository at path and ref, or its default branch, as text of at most 1 MiB; a directory, a binary file or a larger file is refused
